speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the specific movements you are experiencing and when you first noticed them? Also, have you started any new medications recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience an involuntary, repetitive movement, such as jaw clenching, tongue protrusion, or lip smacking? Have you noticed any restlessness or an inability to sit still that started after beginning the risperidone?

text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: These symptoms are classic for akathisia, a side effect of risperidone. I will adjust your medication to alleviate this restlessness. DIAGNOSIS READY: Akathisia
